sys_remote_update_set.description: Landing page screen order. CSM Sales Rep (AE) and Sales Manager screens were both order 20 and managers also hold sales_agent, so managers landed on the AE screen. Sales Manager Landing Page 20 -> 10; AE screen (OOB, Opportunity Management) left at 20. SDR left at 30: AEs also hold Lead Agent, so SDR must stay behind AE. Source: opmsalescrm1 (captured 2026-10-22).
sys_remote_update_set.name: UPDATE-031-landing-page-screen-order
